+import pytest
+from pyparsing.util import make_compressed_re
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("words", [
+    ["parse", "parser", "parsed", "parse", "part"],
+    ["a", "ab", "abc", "abd", "b"],
+    ["[", "]", "-", "^", "\\"],
+    ["a.b", "a+b", "a?b", "a.b"],
+    ["only"],
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_level", [0, 1, 2, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("non_capturing_groups", [False, True])
+def test_single_pass_matches_list(words, max_level, non_capturing_groups):
+    options = dict(max_level=max_level, non_capturing_groups=non_capturing_groups)
+    expected = make_compressed_re(words, **options)
+    assert make_compressed_re((word for word in words), **options) == expected
+    assert make_compressed_re(iter(words), **options) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_level", [0, 1, 2])
+def test_empty_iterator_validation(max_level):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no words given to make_compressed_re"):
+        make_compressed_re(iter(()), max_level=max_level)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("words", [
+    [""],
+    ["abc", ""],
+    ["", "abc"],
+])
+def test_empty_string_iterator_validation(words):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="word list cannot contain empty string"):
+        make_compressed_re((word for word in words))
